summary: Fresenius Medical Care filed a Form 6-K furnishing press releases from its annual general meeting (AGM) held May 21, 2026. The AGM approved a €1.49 dividend and noted completion of a €1 billion share buyback program with a new authorization for share buybacks as part of capital allocation. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, spin-off, restructuring, or other special-situations event is present; the filing is a routine report of a foreign private issuer's shareholder meeting outcomes. Accordingly, no special-situation classification applies.
